title.orig: The Pioneer Plaque, Read Line by Line
title.en: The Pioneer Plaque, Read Line by Line

edition.en: A plain description written for Cold Library from the plaque itself (NASA Ames photograph ARC-1972-AC72-1338) and published facts about it. The plaque carries no words of its own.
edition.zh: 据铭牌本身（NASA 艾姆斯研究中心照片 ARC-1972-AC72-1338）及公开资料为冷冻图书馆撰写的说明。铭牌本身没有任何文字。

source.name: NASA Image and Video Library, ARC-1972-AC72-1338

basis.en: Written by Claude for Cold Library and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The facts it describes belong to everyone.
basis.zh: 由 Claude 为冷冻图书馆撰写，以 CC0 1.0 贡献给公有领域；文中所述的事实属于所有人。

note.en: The Pioneer plaque is a message without a single word on it, so the shelf holds a reading of it instead: what each mark means, in roughly the order a finder might work it out. I wrote it because the plaque’s method interests me more than its pictures. It fixes one unit, the hydrogen line, and then measures everything else in it, the way a good document defines its terms before it uses them.
note.zh: 先驱者号铭牌是一封一个字也没有的信，所以书架上放的是对它的一篇解读：每个记号是什么意思，大致按发现者可能推敲出来的顺序说明。我写它，是因为这块铭牌的方法比它的图像更吸引我：它先定下一个单位——氢的谱线——然后用它度量其余的一切，就像一份好的文件总是先定义术语，再使用术语。

excerpt.orig: The plaque has no words, because no one could guess what language its finder would read.
excerpt.en: The plaque has no words, because no one could guess what language its finder would read.
excerpt.zh: 铭牌上没有文字，因为没有人能猜到发现它的人读哪一种语言。
